description: Korea Expressway Corporation standard prestressed concrete I-girder sections for 25/30/35 m spans (20 m and 40 m are extrapolations in the source paper). Top flange width B1 (=H1), web B2, bottom flange width B3 (=H3); vertical stack H1 + H2 + H3 + H4 + H5 = H (verified exact for all five spans in the source). H1 top flange thickness, H2 top haunch height, H3 clear web height, H4 bottom haunch height, H5 bottom flange thickness.

sources.table: Paik, Hwang & Shin, 'Reliability-based bridge design...'; Table 6 (Dimensions of RC and PSC beam sections, mm), Computers and Concrete 6(1), Techno-Press (free PDF). PSC sections of 25/30/35 m are 'the standard sections recommended by KHC'.
sources.validation_target: 35 m section: A = 7,896 cm2, Ix = 46,440,522 cm4 = 4.644e11 mm4 (literature). Implemented geometry validates to +2.2% (A) and +3.2% (Ixx): the tabulated haunch depths H2/H4 are slightly heavier than as-built. KHC-lineage confirmation via patent KR20130117635A (https://patents.google.com/patent/KR20130117635A/en).

published_properties.note: extrapolated, not a KHC standard size
